column1: # Vietnamese business-name words (curated 2026-11-10), checked against GLEIF's Vietnamese names
# (thương mại, đầu tư, phát triển, xây dựng, dịch vụ). A name is the form, the trade, then a
# two-word Sino-Vietnamese trade name: Công ty TNHH Xây dựng Hoàng Phát, Công ty Cổ phần Thương mại
# Dịch vụ Minh Anh. The Latin form after "=" drops the diacritics, as domains do. A section key
# serves every division of the section that has no row of its own. Columns as in en.tsv.
